verdict.rationale: Milvus is open-source and self-hostable, so users control where data lives. It can store everything in a local file via MilvusClient("milvus_demo.db"), and it runs on a laptop, an edge device, a single machine, Docker, or a user-run Kubernetes cluster. Residency control is therefore implied by deployment choice rather than offered as a documented region or residency feature. Missing for 10: explicit data-residency/region documentation, managed-service region selection, independent corroboration of residency controls.
